name: 道の駅 小石原
desc: 福岡県東峰村の国道211号沿いにある道の駅「小石原」。最大の魅力は、村内約40軒の窯元の作品が一堂に揃う「陶の里館」です。伝統的工芸品の小石原焼や高取焼を比較しながら購入でき、窯元巡りの拠点として最適です。特産品コーナーには、清らかな水が育んだ自慢の「棚田米」や柚子こしょう、朝採れ野菜など、山の幸が並びます。美しい器とおいしい地元食材に出会える憩いのスポットです。
descEn: Located along Route 211 in Toho Village, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Koishiwara" is highly renowned for its traditional crafts. Its main attraction is the "Tou no Sato Yakata," a gallery where works from approximately 40 local kilns are displayed and sold together. This allows visitors to easily compare and purchase traditional Koishiwara and Takatori ware, making it a perfect starting point for kiln-hopping. The local specialty corner offers an array of mountain delicacies, including locally grown "Tanada" (terraced field) rice, yuzu pepper, and freshly harvested vegetables. It is a relaxing spot where you can discover beautiful ceramics and delicious local produce.
